identificationModule.briefTitle: CLL11: A Study of Rituximab With Chlorambucil or Chlorambucil Alone in Patients With Previously Untreated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (Stage 1b)
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multi-center, Three Arm Randomized Study to Investigate the Safety and Efficacy on Progression-free Survival of RO5072759 + Chlorambucil (GClb) Compared to Rituximab + Chlorambucil (RClb) or Chlorambucil (Clb) Alone in Previously Untreated CLL Patients With Comorbidities

armGroups.label: obinutuzumab + chlorambucil (GClb)
armGroups.description: Participants received 1000 mg obinutuzumab intravenous (IV) infusion, on Days 1 \[first infusion split 100 mg on Day 1 and 900 mg on Day 2 as per protocol amendment\], 8 and 15 in Cycle 1 and Day 1 in Cycles 2-6 (28-day cycles) plus chlorambucil 0.5 mg/kg orally on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle (6 Cycles).

armGroups.label: rituximab + chlorambucil (RClb)
armGroups.description: Participants received 375 mg/m\^2 rituximab IV infusion on Day 1 of Cycle 1 then 500 mg/m\^2 IV infusions on Day 1 of Cycles 2-6 (28-day cycles) plus chlorambucil 0.5 mg/kg orally on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle (6 cycles).

armGroups.label: Chlorambucil (Clb)
armGroups.description: Participants received chlorambucil 0.5 mg/kg orally on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle (6 Cycles). Participants with Progressive Disease or within 6 months of follow-up were allowed to cross over to receive obinutuzumab + chlorambucil.

interventions.name: obinutuzumab
interventions.description: 1000 mg obinutuzumab intravenous (IV) infusion, on Days 1 \[first infusion split 100 mg on Day 1 and 900 mg on Day 2 as per protocol amendment\], 8 and 15 in Cycle 1 and Day 1 in Cycles 2-6 (28-day cycles).

interventions.name: rituximab
interventions.description: 375 mg/m\^2 rituximab intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of Cycle 1 (Cycle duration is 28 days) then 500 mg/m\^2 IV infusions on Day 1 of Cycles 2-6.

interventions.name: chlorambucil
interventions.description: Chlorambucil 0.5 mg/kg orally on Day 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
